reply_text:
I didn't record Tobias's figure of 382 seats for Marrow Agrisupply, because the company records say 40. I explained this to him in a reply to his message in #central-team.

- The Affiliate Amendment, effective 2025-10-15, sets Marrow Agrisupply at 40 seats on SLA Tier 1.
- The 2026 renewal order form (signed 22 Apr 2026, effective 1 May 2026) says it doesn't change Agrisupply's seat count. So 40 still applies through 30 Apr 2027.
- The account page and the 23 Apr CRM note also show 40.

I asked him to point me to any newer amendment or order form if 382 is right. Nothing has been updated. The reply only mentions seat counts and dates, no money terms.
